On-page content and metadata optimization across product pages.

Used consistent event metadata (dates, venues, categories) across listings to keep the catalogue structured as new events are added.

name: Treppenlift Experten NRW

engagement: Website Design & Regional Local SEO Structure

projectOverview: Treppenlift Experten NRW sells, rents, and finances new and used stairlifts across North Rhine-Westphalia, offering free on-site consultations and helping customers apply for care-insurance subsidies of up to €4,180.
challenge: Stairlift buyers are often researching urgently on behalf of an aging parent, and comparing multiple regional providers. The site needed to build fast trust, make the subsidy process feel manageable, and rank across many individual NRW cities rather than just one regional homepage.
strategy: Built individual city-specific service pages (Dortmund, Köln, Essen, Düsseldorf, Bochum, Bielefeld, Bonn, Münster, and more) instead of one generic regional page.
Led the homepage with the subsidy angle — up to €4,180 in support — since cost is typically the first objection for stairlift buyers.
Introduced named regional contacts (David-Wilhelm Steffen nationally, Sofia Steffen for NRW) to make the buying process feel personal rather than corporate.
solutions: Added a manufacturer-independent positioning to reassure buyers the recommendation isn't tied to pushing one specific stairlift brand.
Built out buy/rent/finance as three distinct, clearly explained paths rather than assuming every visitor wants to purchase outright.
Published ongoing blog content covering stairlift costs and city-specific subsidy information to support buyers earlier in their research.
seoWork: Created dedicated local landing pages for each major NRW city served, each targeting that city's stairlift search terms specifically.
Used consistent trust signals (installations completed, years of experience, satisfied customers) across every regional page.
Linked out to sibling regional sites (Herford, Hüllhorst, Bünde, Minden-Lübbecke) to reinforce topical and geographic authority across the wider service area.
achievements: Built dedicated local landing pages for major NRW cities instead of relying on a single regional homepage.
Made the €4,180 care-insurance subsidy a central, upfront part of the pitch rather than a buried detail.
Displayed on-site trust signals including a German Customer Award and manufacturer-independent positioning.
conclusion: The site funnels visitors toward a free local consultation, backed by city-specific service pages across NRW and a dedicated regional point of contact.

faqs.question: Can stairlifts be rented instead of purchased?
faqs.answer: Yes, Treppenlift Experten NRW offers buying, renting, and financing options for stairlifts.

faqs.question: Is financial support available?
faqs.answer: The company helps customers apply for care-insurance subsidies of up to €4,180 per person and handles the paperwork with the Pflegekasse.

faqs.answer: The site lists dedicated service pages for cities including Dortmund, Köln, Essen, Düsseldorf, Bochum, Bielefeld, Bonn, and Münster.
